posts.text: 🤖 AI Platform Against Claude Cowork, DeepSeek opens its open-source Harness to developers TechNode (China) · 🟧 Claude · 🐳 DeepSeek · 🌏 Asia · 5h ago • DeepSeek launched Harness, an open-source agent framework with web interface competing with Anthropic's Claude Cowork. • Harness uses plugin-based architecture for extensible AI agent capabilities. • Project positions DeepSeek as alternative for developers building AI agents. 📰 Also covered by: Pandaily (China) Read more →

🤖 AI Platform DeepSeek to introduce peak and off-peak pricing for its API TechNode (China) · 🐳 DeepSeek · 🌏 Asia · 5h ago • DeepSeek implementing dynamic pricing for API starting August 17 with peak/off-peak rates. • Peak hours: 9am-noon and 2pm-6pm Beijing time; off-peak rates set at 50% of peak. • Pricing structure aims to manage demand during high-usage periods. 📰 Also covered by: Pandaily (China) Read more →
